reviews.review: I love this game will probally be playing it in the future with freinds. My only complaint its easy to connect with people on the ps4 but on the pc its a little bit complicted where it doesnt need to be.

What a fun game. When you first start playing, you can feel a bit overwhelmed until you get a grasp on what you're supposed to do - get to the teleporter by any means necessary. The longer you wait, the more the game works against you. The fun for me comes in the scaling difficulty, and that scaling is based on how efficient you're making your way though the game and the items that you get. After the first 5 levels, you have an option to loop and that is where more of the difficulty comes from. The scale really ramps up and it's a lot of fun trying to keep yourself alive while multiple bosses are thrown at you.

What keeps me coming back is the variation in game play. Between the characters, a massive amount of items, and relics that act as game modifiers (similar to Halo's skulls), there are plenty of things to keep this game interesting. I don't think that I'll even uninstall this game as it's a fun way to game when I'm short on time; a single loop through the levels takes about 30 minutes.

One last thing I want to mention is the music. I really enjoy it and find that it adds a wonderful bit of mood to each level and boss fight.

Warning to any Linux users: there are game-breaking bugs when playing on Linux, and the developer has moved on with no chance for a fix (you can find more info in the steam discussion boards, just search for "linux" and you'll find them). Linux gamers are advised to stay away.
